title: Grateful Dead Live at Temple University on 1970-05-16
lineage: AUD MC > ? > Cass > CD/0 > EAC > WAV > Soundforge > SHN

ai_review.summary: Rough audience cassette with muddy mix but captures a brief, energetic 1970 set featuring a lively New Speedway Boogie and clear Jerry Garcia guitar.
ai_review.review: The tape is an audience‑sourced recording that suffers from heavy crowd noise, low vocal levels and a generally muddy sound, though listeners note that Garcia’s guitar cuts through clearly. Musically the show is short yet spirited, with highlights like a driving New Speedway Boogie and a joyful rendition of Working Man’s Dead that many fans remember fondly. Overall it offers an intriguing snapshot of a rare 1970 performance despite its technical flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is praised for energy and specific song moments (average ~4 stars), but recording quality is frequently described as noisy and muddy (average ~2 stars). Weighted combination yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Heavy audience noise, low vocal levels, overall muddiness; however some reviewers note clear Jerry Garcia guitar and occasional moments of good clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short (under an hour) but lively set; the energy stays high throughout despite limited time, with a memorable New Speedway Boogie and a joyous Workingman's Dead.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar is described as clear and cutting through the otherwise muddy mix.
